note: site header -- renders the operator's fixed logo, navigation, search control, and account controls
site logo -- renders the operator's fixed logo and tagline
main-menu control -- renders the fixed platform menu toggle
search submission control -- renders the fixed search button
account and support navigation -- renders fixed links such as Donate, Create account, and Log in
language selector control -- renders the fixed language-selection control
associated-page tabs -- renders the fixed Article and Talk tab vocabulary
page-view tabs -- renders the fixed View, Edit, and History controls
page-tools control -- renders the fixed page-tools menu toggle
appearance preferences -- renders fixed controls for font size, page width, and theme
help indicator -- renders the fixed platform help control
site subtitle -- renders fixed Wikimedia site copy
sister-project information text -- renders fixed Wikimedia project-navigation copy and links
rendering attribution -- renders fixed MediaWiki platform attribution
copyright and licensing notice -- renders fixed operator-authored legal and license copy
footer navigation -- renders fixed links such as Privacy, About, Disclaimers, Contact, Developers, and Mobile view
